graph_nodes.name: SurfElem
graph_nodes.description: Creates shells or membranes with default properties from given meshes. Mesh edges that meet at a common point are thus connected with each other. Karamba3D assumes input to be in [m].

values.Description: Information regarding the conversion of lines to beams.
values.Name: Info

values.Description: These meshes will be connected if their vertices meet.
values.Name: Mesh

values.Description: Colour of the shell. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input meshes.
values.Name: Colour

values.Description: Identifier of the shells in the model. Need not be unique. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input meshes.
values.Name: Id

values.Description: Cross-section of the shell. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input meshes.
values.Name: CroSec

values.Description: If ‘True’, the shell has bending stiffness. Otherwise, it is a membrane.
values.Name: Bending

values.Description: List of points which will be inserted at the beginning of the node-list at the output-plug. This makes it easy to reference them by index in the model later. May contain duplicate points. In case of duplicate points elements are attached to them alternating: first element to first duplicate point, second element to second duplicate point, third element to first duplicate point in case there are only two points in one position.
values.Name: Pts

graph_nodes.name: LineElem
graph_nodes.description: Geometry is assumed to be given in [m]. Creates beams with default properties from given lines, indexes or connectivity diagrams. Lines that meet at a common point are thus connected with each other. Karamba3D assumes input to be in [m].

values.Description: Information regarding the conversion of lines to beams.
values.Name: Info

values.Description: Line which will be connected to others if they meet at common points. Node indexes may change if lines are added.
values.Name: Line

values.Description: Colour of the beam. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input lines.
values.Name: Colour

values.Description: Identifier of the beam. Need not be unique in a model. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input lines.
values.Name: Id

values.Description: Cross-section of the beam. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input lines.
values.Name: CroSec

values.Description: New orientation of the local Z-axis of beam. If the vector has zero length, the default orientation remains in place.
values.Name: Z-Ori

values.Description: Buckling length [m] of element in local Y-direction if > 0.
values.Name: BklLenY

values.Description: Buckling length [m] of element in local Z-direction if > 0.
values.Name: BklLenZ

values.Description: Buckling length [m] of element for lateral torsional buckling if > 0.
values.Name: BklLenLT

values.Description: If 'True' the beam has bending stiffness. Otherwise, it is a truss.
values.Name: Bending

values.Description: For converting splines into polylines: Maximum angle (0 to pi) between tangents at adjacent vertices.
values.Name: ToPAng

values.Description: For converting splines into polylines: If tolerance = 0, the parameter is ignored. This parameter controls the maximum permitted value of the distance in the base unit for geometry input from the curve to the polyline.
values.Name: ToPTol

values.Description: For converting splines into polylines: If maxEdgeLength = 0, the parameter is ignored. This parameter controls the maximum permitted edge length in the base unit for geometry input.
values.Name: ToPMaxL

values.Description: List of points which will be inserted at the beginning of the node-list at the output-plug. This makes it easy to reference them by index in the model later. May contain duplicate points. In case of duplicate points elements are attached to them alternating: first element to first duplicate point, second element to second duplicate point, third element to first duplicate point in case there are only two points in one position.
values.Name: Pts

values.Description: If false, a line only results in an element if it connects to points given in the 'Points' input-plug.
values.Name: New

values.Description: Remove duplicate lines - otherwise there could be two elements on the same spot which is normally not preferred.
values.Name: Remove

graph_nodes.name: CroSecSelect
graph_nodes.description: Lets you select cross sections by name or regular expression from a list of cross sections.

values.Description: Input list of cross-sections for the selection. If nothing is given the default cross-section table is used.
values.Name: CroSec

values.Description: Names of cross-sections to select (e.g., 'HEA100') or indexes of cross-sections in list. Cross-section names are case-insensitive, blanks will be removed. Everything that comes after '#' is comment. The first cross-section whose name matches is selected. Regular expressions start with '&'.
values.Name: Name|Ind
values.NickName: Name or list index of cross-section

values.Description: Identifiers of beams or beams with identifiers to attach a cross-section to. In case there are more cross-sections than element identifiers the last element identifier will be copied according to the longest list principle. In case there are more element identifiers than cross-sections, the remaining element identifiers get attached to the last cross-section.
values.Name: Elems|Ids

values.Description: Material used for the cross section. If nothing is given the material will not be affected.
values.Name: Mat

values.Description: Information regarding the selection of cross-sections.
values.Name: Info

graph_nodes.name: CroSecRSelect
graph_nodes.description: Lets you select cross sections by country, shape, family or maximum depth or width.

values.Description: Input cross sections for the selection. If nothing is given the default cross section table is used.
values.Name: CroSec

values.Description: Maximum height [cm] of cross sections in selected cross section range. If < 0 no limit is assumed.
values.Name: maxH

values.Description: Maximum width [cm] of cross sections in selected cross section range. If < 0 no limit is assumed.
values.Name: MaxWidth

values.Description: Identifiers of beams or beams with identifiers to attach a cross section to. In case there are more cross sections than element identifiers the last element identifier will be copied according to the longest list principle. In case there are more element identifiers than cross sections, the remaining element identifiers get attached to the last cross section.
values.Name: Elems|Ids

values.Description: Material used for the cross section. If nothing is given the material will not be affected.
values.Name: Mat

values.Name: Name|Ind

values.Description: Identifier of element or element with identifier to attach a material to.
values.Name: Elem|Id

graph_nodes.name: Analyse, Analyze
graph_nodes.description: Calculates the deflections of a given model.

values.Description: Model for which to calculate deflections.
values.Name: Model

values.Description: Load cases for which to calculate deflections.
values.Name: LCase

values.Description: Maximum displacement [cm] of each load-case of the model at endpoints and mid-points of elements.
values.Name: MaxDisp

values.Description: Resulting force of external loads [kN] of each calculated load case in global directions.
values.Name: Force

values.Description: Change of the internal elastic energy [kNm] of each load-cases of the model computed as the scalar product of external nodal loads and nodal displacements.
values.Name: Energy

graph_nodes.name: ModelView
graph_nodes.description: Lets you inspect the current state of the model. Plug it into the data pipeline in front of 'Beam View' or 'Shell View' to control the overall model display.

values.Description: Select load case to be displayed in each point of the structure by providing a string of the following form: 'LoadCaseCombinationName/SelectionCriterion1/SelectionCriterion2/...'.
values.Name: LCase

values.Description: This list of colours is used for rendering coloured meshes. The first colour is used for values below the currently visible range. The last colour is used for values above the currently visible range. All other colours are evenly distributed in the visible range. The minimum number of colours to be supplied is four.
values.Name: Colours

values.Description: List of identifiers of elements which shall be displayed and/or breps, base-lines, planes, surfaces which define visibility via the element nodes inside or on them. By default, all elements are displayed. In case identifiers and geometry items are given only those elements are visible which fulfill both criteria.
values.Name: View

values.Description: Input a vector for specifying the direction of the displacement component to be displayed. Alternatively supply a plane to project the displacements on it. By default, the resultant displacements are shown.
values.Name: defDir

values.Description: Axes of deformed structure (if enabled - see 'Elements' checkbox).
values.Name: DefAxes

values.Description: Deformed Model with nodal displacements as displayed. To save computational resources, the output is created only in case the output-plug in connected to another component. Connect the output-plug and reevaluate the ModelView-component to get the expected output.
values.Name: DefModel

values.Description: Maximum displacement [cm] of the displayed model parts. The setting of the 'defDir'-input is considered.
values.Name: DefMax

graph_nodes.name: ShellView
graph_nodes.description: Lets you inspect the current state of the shells in a model. Plug it into the definition after a ModelView-component so that you can fine-tune the model display with it.

values.Description: Index of the layer to be displayed. '0' is the default.
values.Name: LayerInd

values.Description: Mesh of rendered structure: one mesh per shell or beam to keep the list order. The placeholder meshes for beams are 'Null Meshes'. The exception is the display of shell cross sections: here beams are not included and there are two meshes per shell (top- and bottom-fibre).
values.Name: Mesh

graph_nodes.name: BeamView
graph_nodes.description: Lets you set the display properties of beams and trusses. Plug it into the definition after a ModelView-component so that you can fine-tune the model display with it.

values.Description: Mesh of rendered structure: one mesh per shell or beam to keep the list order. The placeholder meshes for shells are 'Null Meshes'.
values.Name: Mesh

values.Description: Lines of sectional forces distribution (if enabled).
values.Name: Curves

values.Description: Centre of gravity of the model. Point masses are not included since version 2.0.0.
values.Name: COG

values.Description: Limit distance [m] for coincident points (for point-loads, supports given with coordinates).
values.Name: LDist

values.Description: List of points which will be inserted at the beginning of the node-list at the output-plug. This makes it easy to reference them by index in the model later. May contain duplicate points. In case of duplicate points elements are attached to them alternating: first element to first duplicate point, second element to second duplicate point, third element to first duplicate point in case there are only two points in one position.

values.Description: Input cross-sections of the model. Can be used to override the cross-section definitions at the elements.

values.Description: Input materials of the model. Can be used to override the material-section definitions via cross-sections at the elements.

graph_nodes.name: ModelView
graph_nodes.description: Lets you inspect the current state of the model. Plug it into the data pipeline in front of 'Beam View' or 'Shell View' to control the overall model display.

values.Description: Select load case to be displayed in each point of the structure by providing a string of the following form: 'LoadCaseCombinationName/SelectionCriterion1/SelectionCriterion2/...'.
values.Name: LCase

values.Description: This list of colours is used for rendering coloured meshes. The first colour is used for values below the currently visible range. The last colour is used for values above the currently visible range. All other colours are evenly distributed in the visible range. The minimum number of colours to be supplied is four.
values.Name: Colours

values.Description: List of identifiers of elements which shall be displayed and/or breps, base-lines, planes, surfaces which define visibility via the element nodes inside or on them. By default, all elements are displayed. In case identifiers and geometry items are given only those elements are visible which fulfill both criteria.
values.Name: View

values.Description: Input a vector for specifying the direction of the displacement component to be displayed. Alternatively supply a plane to project the displacements on it. By default, the resultant displacements are shown.
values.Name: defDir

values.Description: Axes of deformed structure (if enabled - see 'Elements' checkbox).
values.Name: DefAxes

values.Description: Deformed Model with nodal displacements as displayed. To save computational resources, the output is created only in case the output-plug in connected to another component. Connect the output-plug and reevaluate the ModelView-component to get the expected output.
values.Name: DefModel

values.Description: Maximum displacement [cm] of the displayed model parts. The setting of the 'defDir'-input is considered.
values.Name: DefMax

graph_nodes.name: LineElem
graph_nodes.description: Geometry is assumed to be given in [m]. Creates beams with default properties from given lines, indexes or connectivity diagrams. Lines that meet at a common point are thus connected with each other. Karamba3D assumes input to be in [m].

values.Description: Information regarding the conversion of lines to beams.
values.Name: Info

values.Description: Line which will be connected to others if they meet at common points. Node indexes may change if lines are added.
values.Name: Line

values.Description: Colour of the beam. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input lines.
values.Name: Colour

values.Description: Identifier of the beam. Need not be unique in a model. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input lines.
values.Name: Id

values.Description: Cross-section of the beam. The component applies the longest list principle with respect to the input lines.
values.Name: CroSec

values.Description: New orientation of the local Z-axis of beam. If the vector has zero length, the default orientation remains in place.
values.Name: Z-Ori

values.Description: Buckling length [m] of element in local Y-direction if > 0.
values.Name: BklLenY

values.Description: Buckling length [m] of element in local Z-direction if > 0.
values.Name: BklLenZ

values.Description: Buckling length [m] of element for lateral torsional buckling if > 0.
values.Name: BklLenLT

values.Description: If 'True' the beam has bending stiffness. Otherwise, it is a truss.
values.Name: Bending

values.Description: For converting splines into polylines: Maximum angle (0 to pi) between tangents at adjacent vertices.
values.Name: ToPAng

values.Description: For converting splines into polylines: If tolerance = 0, the parameter is ignored. This parameter controls the maximum permitted value of the distance in the base unit for geometry input from the curve to the polyline.
values.Name: ToPTol

values.Description: For converting splines into polylines: If maxEdgeLength = 0, the parameter is ignored. This parameter controls the maximum permitted edge length in the base unit for geometry input.
values.Name: ToPMaxL

values.Description: List of points which will be inserted at the beginning of the node-list at the output-plug. This makes it easy to reference them by index in the model later. May contain duplicate points. In case of duplicate points elements are attached to them alternating: first element to first duplicate point, second element to second duplicate point, third element to first duplicate point in case there are only two points in one position.
values.Name: Pts

values.Description: If false, a line only results in an element if it connects to points given in the 'Points' input-plug.
values.Name: New

values.Description: Remove duplicate lines - otherwise there could be two elements on the same spot which is normally not preferred.
values.Name: Remove
